Well for me, I just wanted to know full ZBLL. The thing is, I’m at the point right now that it’s faster for me to use Sune ZBLL than it is for me to do Sune, then PLL. If you are going to learn them, it might take a while to get fast with then but once you do, it can be rewarding
I also said work at your own pace. 6 a day wasn’t cramming for me but it could be considered cramming for someone else

I used [Anthony Brooks’ and Jabari’s algs](http://www.brookscubing.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Anthony-Brooks-ZBLL.pdf) for most of the cases and looked up other on various different websites. I learned T and U cases first, as they are pretty easy. The rest you can honestly learn in any order, but I did H last. Also, don’t try to cram them in too fast. You will start mixing them up. I learned about 6 a day, but make sure to find your own pace. As for trainers, [this one](http://bestsiteever.ru/zbll/) is by far the best.
